facts.fact: BOCRA's newsletter says the Botswana Internet Exchange (BINX), established by the Internet Service Providers Association, continues to play a vital role in local Internet infrastructure; it describes a stakeholder workshop held at BOCRA on 15 October 2025, and notes financial sustainability, outdated equipment and governance delays.
BOCRA's newsletter says BINX supports local Internet infrastructure through its Google Cache Cluster and a Packet Clearing House node.
